description: A giving history, one row per gift, for Data Import. Download its template from a new Data Import, or map the columns of a payment processor's export. It keeps no records: each row adds a Donation to a draft Collection of its batch and date, and Finance submits the Collections.

fields.description: The gift's ID in the system it comes from, such as a Stripe charge ID. A gift is imported once.
fields.label: Gift ID

fields.description: The whole amount the giver paid.
fields.label: Amount

fields.description: The system the giver's Person ID comes from, as on the People import. Spreadsheet when blank.
fields.label: Imported From

fields.description: The giver's ID in that system. When no one was imported with it, the email finds the giver.
fields.label: Person ID

fields.description: Finds the giver when the Person ID does not. Only one person may have it.
fields.label: Email

fields.description: Gifts with the same batch and date go in one Collection. The Data Import's name when blank.
fields.label: Batch

name: Giving Import
